summary: Frontend-only retest at 375x667 for TimeGuard focus features (A) schedule-based locking and (B) native panel fallback on web. Full flow validated with two isolated browser contexts (parent + monitored, anonymous). Current system time ~07:16 UTC used for out-of-range window (09:00-10:00). PASS RESULTS: (1) Regression login: padre.test@timeguard.dev / Familia123 lands on ParentDashboard, Landing shows role-parent + role-monitored, no red-screen / no pageerror after adding the local Android native module (nativeUsage.requireOptionalNativeModule('TimeguardUsage') returns null on web as designed). (2) Preparation: summary-pair -> pairing-generate produced pairing code B6YTB8; in a fresh context role-monitored -> join-code B6YTB8 -> join-submit joined anonymously and displayed MonitoredScreen (monitored-exit visible). (3) Native fallback (B): MonitoredScreen shows testID native-unavailable with text 'Se activan al instalar el build de Android'; testID native-panel is NOT rendered; app does not crash. (4) Out-of-range schedule (A): Parent Controles -> schedule-add with 09:00-10:00 -> MonitoredScreen realtime-transitioned into testID monitored-locked with title 'Fuera del horario' and message 'Próxima franja "Fuera-de-rango" a las 09:00' and testID request-more-locked visible. (5) In-range schedule (A): Adding a second schedule 00:00-23:59 -> MonitoredScreen unlocks: monitored-locked disappears and testID schedule-within shows 'Dentro de tu horario: Todo-el-dia' with 'Puedes usar el dispositivo ahora mismo.' (6) Regression requests: request-more from monitored -> monitored-pending appears; parent Actividad shows request-<id>; approve-<id> => APROBADA. (7) Manual block priority: with covering schedule still enabled, toggling control-block ON => MonitoredScreen shows monitored-locked with title 'Tiempo en pausa' (parent-block takes precedence over schedule window as spec'd). No console errors, no React Native red-screen. Test device 8d62e6aa-ab13-4a37-8198-08bc968b0ee7 was DELETED via Supabase REST (status 204) at teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/schedule.ts scheduleStatus() correctly supports overnight windows (a<=b vs wrap-around) and returns proper restricted/allowed/currentLabel/nextStart flags — verified via both 09:00-10:00 (out) and 00:00-23:59 (in) cases.

MonitoredScreen realtime channel now subscribes to devices, extra_time_requests, device_limits and schedules filtered by device_id, plus a 30s tick to re-evaluate the window. The realtime propagation was fast (<1s) in tests, so no polling was required.

nativeUsage.ts uses requireOptionalNativeModule('TimeguardUsage') so web/Expo Go gracefully returns null and usageAvailable=false — the MonitoredScreen guards on usageAvailable to render native-unavailable, preventing any crash from the new local Android module.
ParentDashboard.tsx (460+ lines with 6 sub-components) is still worth splitting for maintainability (previous iteration comment persists) but is functionally correct.
